newsitem.title: SWEDEN: POLL-Astra H1 profit seen rising 6 pct.
newsitem.headline: POLL-Astra H1 profit seen rising 6 pct.

text.p: Swedish drugs major Astra is expected to post a six percent rise in pre-tax profit to 7.18 billion crowns in the first six months of the year, a Reuters poll of 15 analysts found on Monday.
Forecasts ranged from 7.04 billion crowns to 7.39 billion, compared with 6.76 billion for the first half of 1996.
Analysts expect six-month sales to rise 11 percent to 21.19 billion crowns.
For the full-year, they see pre-tax profit advancing 12 percent to 14.82 billion crowns compared to average estimates for 1997 of 15.68 billion crowns ahead of the first quarter report.

Analysts interviewed from the poll came from: Aragon, Aros, BZW, Carnegie, CI Nordic, CSFB, Fischer Partners, Goldman Sachs, Handelsbanken, James Capel, Kleinwort Benson, Morgan Stanley, Myrberg & Wiklund, Paribas, SBC Warburg, Swedbank and Ohman.
Astra is due to present six-month earnings on August 8.
